title: Want an expert’s advice on how to save more or grow the savings you’ve already got? Send us your questions | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

For CNN’s upcoming Savings Challenge this fall, we’re launching a feature that will provide answers to reader questions from Douglas Boneparth, a certified financial planner and founder of Bone Fide Wealth.

Whether you’re looking for smart ideas about how to save more, wondering how to balance saving money with paying down debt or just hoping to get advice on how to manage the savings you’ve already got, please send us your biggest questions. They may be addressed in upcoming articles.
